title: The Silent Lab
setting: University research lab, chemistry department, late night
incident: Graduate student Yoon Jaehee found dead from chemical exposure in Lab 307 at 6:20 AM
motive_hint: Plagiarism dispute — Park discovered Yoon was using his unpublished data in her thesis without credit
method_hint: Swapped labels on sodium azide (NaN3) container with sodium chloride (NaCl), knowing Yoon's experiment required adding acid to NaCl — acid + NaN3 produces lethal hydrazoic acid gas
causal_chain: Swapped label → Yoon added HCl to what she thought was NaCl → actually NaN3 → hydrazoic acid gas released → lab ventilation was set to recirculate mode (maintenance schedule) → lethal concentration in sealed room
extra_constraints: Set in a Korean university. Include a lab safety inspection log that shows ventilation was recently changed to recirculate mode for HVAC maintenance. The key contradiction: Park claims he left campus at 5PM but his lab access card shows a 2AM entry.
